reserveReview.rationale: The issuer positions API accessed 2026-09-30 reports $4,909,493,244.78 of backing, reconciled exactly to its positive rows at source timestamp 1790724310 (2026-09-29). The existing adapter emits Liquid Cash 81.1%, ETH / liquid staking collateral 7.6%, BTC 9.9%, and Other crypto 1.4%. The category endpoint separately reports a $1,404,244,668 Liquid Stables bucket naming USDT, USDC, USDtb and PYUSD, without per-token balances. Its $4,900,605,327 category denominator differs from the collateral endpoint; no category fraction is multiplied into the legacy Liquid Cash envelope. RWA likewise names JAAA and STAC without individual balances. No constituent links are authored.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Existing Ethena adapter output from the issuer collateral positions payload accessed 2026-09-30; source timestamp 1790724310; category disclosure retained only as non-additive research evidence
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 81.1% Liquid Cash basket remains allocation-unresolved. Named stablecoins and tokenized funds in the category endpoint lack per-asset balances and a reconciled cross-endpoint checkpoint. Issuer questionnaire pending.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Blocked on issuer per-asset balances: USDT, USDC, USDtb and PYUSD are named in one $1,404,244,668 category, while JAAA and STAC share a separate RWA category. The two endpoints have different totals and supply no per-token balances; retain candidates only, without guessed allocations.
Delta-hedged ETH and liquid-staking-token backing is an external crypto, staking, and derivatives exposure, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ethena names Copper, Ceffu, and Fireblocks as off-exchange settlement providers and states that protocol assets remain beneficially owned by the protocol, while Copper and Ceffu use commingled omnibus wallets. Provider allocation shares across the stablecoin, DeFi lending, RWA, institutional lending, and crypto-basis categories, and contractual outcomes in each provider or exchange insolvency, are not public.
